note: Banco Atlántida only, as before: Banco Agrícola's, Banco Cuscatlán's, Davivienda's and BAC's card tariffs weren't reached in this pass. Banco Atlántida El Salvador's charges for its One credit card (updated 1 June 2026), read in full: a nominal interest rate of up to 51.95% a year, written at that top; no membership fee; a cash withdrawal of up to 5% of the sum, at least 5 dollars (nothing at the bank's own counters), written at 5%; a monthly late charge of 5% of the capital in arrears, at most 25 dollars, written as a share of the unpaid part; 15 dollars for a cheque payment returned; no moratory interest. Its amounts are before VAT, at a rate the document doesn't state, so none is added. No minimum payment, grace period or foreign transaction fee is stated.
